title: Lucky Block Challenge
description: Lucky Block Challenge!, Lucky Blocks, Lucky OneBlock, Lucky Race, Lucky Games, Lucky Pillars and more!
body:
![Lucky Block Challenge Header](https://www.bisecthosting.com/images/CF/LuckyBlock_Challenge/BH_LC_Header.webp)
[![Lucky Block Challenge Bisecthosting](https://www.bisecthosting.com/images/CF/LuckyBlock_Challenge/BH_LC_PromoCard.webp)](https://tinyurl.com/amy67484)
![Lucky Block Challenge Overview](https://www.bisecthosting.com/images/CF/LuckyBlock_Challenge/BH_LC_Overview.webp)
---
Lucky Block Challenge is a fantasy Modpack based on the Lucky Block Mod. Are ya feeling lucky? Jump into the world of lucky blocks and start your lucky adventure today! Choose from a variety of custom pre-built maps ranging from lucky block skyblock through to a lucky block race with friends!

---
<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/6TQLRJDchAk?si=byPKX80wEWOBkGo6" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" referrerpolicy="strict-origin-when-cross-origin" allowfullscreen></iframe>

![Lucky Block Challenge Features](https://www.bisecthosting.com/images/CF/LuckyBlock_Challenge/BH_LC_Features.webp)
---
- [🗺️] **Maps** - Play solo or with friends in our custom Lucky Block designed maps!
- [🍀] **Luck** - Who doesn't love feeling lucky! Open a few Lucky Blocks here and there.
